codex:
**Verdict: (B) material improvement.**

The mathematics is otherwise strong and discharged, but the headline undersells a free scope transfer.

The note’s class is **not** Squires et al.’s full published class. The note says:

> “The observed-coordinate, centered, fully covered perfect-stochastic-intervention subclass…”

and defines \(\mathcal M_p\) using labeled coordinates, one observational component, one effective perfect surgery per node, and pooled positive mixture weights. Its honest scope explicitly says:

> “latent coordinate mixing … [is] outside the positive theorem.”

Squires et al. allow latent dimension \(d\), observed dimension \(p\ge d\), and an arbitrary injective linear observation map \(X=GZ\). Their Proposition 10 concerns the unknown observational context in that broader class. [Published paper, Assumptions 1–2 and Proposition 10](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v202/squires23a/squires23a.pdf).

However, every note model embeds into the published perfect-intervention class by taking anchor \(d=p\), observation map \(G=I_p\), \(H=I_p\), and normalized mechanism matrices
\[
\mathsf B_0=\Omega^{-1/2}A,\qquad
\mathsf B_j=\mathsf B_0+e_j\bigl(\tau_j^{-1/2}e_j-\mathsf B_0^\top e_j\bigr)^\top .
\]
Thus \(\Theta_j=K_j\), and the two-node, fork, and star witnesses are legal instances of the anchor’s own class. Therefore:

- the positive coordinate certificate remains only a subclass result;
- the counterexamples refute Proposition 10 over its full published domain by inclusion;
- the rank-only impossibility likewise transfers to the full published domain, since any universally correct selector there would restrict to one on \(\mathcal M_p\).

Current note wording only says:

> “Theorem 2 strictly replaces the unknown-baseline promise of Proposition 10 … on the observed-coordinate fully covered perfect-intervention subclass”

and

> “no component-permutation-equivariant rank-only selector universally recovers the baseline on \(\mathcal M_p\).”

That misses a material scope/headline elbow.

### Exact scoped D0 directive

1. **`thm:rank-selector-correction`**  
   Add the explicit embedding above to the statement/proof. State that the displayed witnesses falsify Proposition 10 on the paper’s full stated class, while \(\mathsf{Cert}\) repairs baseline selection only on the observed-coordinate fully covered subclass.

2. **`thm:rank-only-impossibility`**  
   Strengthen the consequence to: no component-permutation-equivariant rank-only selector universally recovers the observational context on the Squires et al. Proposition-10 class. Prove this solely by restriction to the embedded star family; do not claim positive recovery under latent mixing.

3. Synchronize **`tldr`**, **`project_justification.gap`**, **`project_justification.niche`**, **`related_work`**, the Squires **`comparator_promise_table`** entry, both theorems’ `justification/gap/consumer`, and **`honest_scope`** with the distinction: *negative result transfers to the published class; positive certificate does not*.

4. Apply these two mechanical prose corrections:

   - **Kumar–Sinha:**  
     “Kumar and Sinha’s Theorem 3.1 is an exact-oracle result for finite discrete CBNs: given \(G\), \(P(V)\), and \(P_{\mathrm{mix}}(V)\), it uniquely recovers intervention tuples and weights under exclusion and positivity. It is not a sample-based estimator of unlabeled component covariances.”  
     This matches their actual theorem. [UAI 2021, Theorem 3.1](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v161/kumar21a/kumar21a.pdf).

   - **Gamella et al.:**  
     “Gamella et al. characterize the \(I\)-equivalence class for separately indexed linear-SCM environments with a common coefficient matrix and noise-variance interventions, under faithfulness, intervention heterogeneity, and model truthfulness. Their input retains environment labels and does not provide the unlabeled estimation front end or treat perfect row-deletion surgeries.”  
     Pin the cited version: this is Theorem 6 in the 2022 manuscript and Theorem 1 in arXiv v4. [Current arXiv version](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2211.14897).

No further material rate, construction, or bound is presently available: the growing-\(p\) mixture operator tail remains genuinely open, and improving the displayed stability constants or real-arithmetic complexity would not change tier.

REPAIR, not RETRACT. The permutation embedding is valid under Squires et al.’s reverse-topological order, pseudoinverse normalization, perfect-intervention form, and precision formula. [Official source: Assumptions 1–2, Remark 1, and Eq. (2).](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v202/squires23a/squires23a.pdf)

Verbatim judgment-codex directive:

> ARCHIVE-SOUNDNESS REPAIR — Preserve the achieved subfield tier and every \(\mathcal M_p\) result; close only the five D0.5 findings. In `lem:squires-class-embedding`, reserve \(\sigma=(0\,1)\) for the component-context swap used in `thm:rank-only-impossibility` and introduce a distinct reverse-topological bijection \(\rho:V\to[p]\) satisfying \(u\to v\Rightarrow\rho(u)>\rho(v)\). Let \(Q\) be its permutation matrix, \(Qe_j=e_{\rho(j)}\). Write the core normalized mechanisms as
> \[
> \mathcal C_0=\Omega^{-1/2}A,\qquad
> \mathcal C_j=(\Omega^{(j)})^{-1/2}A^{(j)}
> =\mathcal C_0+e_jc_j^\top,
> \quad
> c_j=\tau_j^{-1/2}e_j-\mathcal C_0^\top e_j.
> \]
> Relabel only the latent nodes, not the observed context labels: context \(j\) has Squires target \(i_j=\rho(j)\). Set
> \[
> d=p,\qquad
> G_{\rm Sq}=Q^\top,\qquad
> H_{\rm Sq}=G_{\rm Sq}^{\dagger}=Q,\qquad
> \mathcal B_c^{\rm Sq}=Q\mathcal C_cQ^\top .
> \]
> Equivalently, the relabeled latent adjacency and noise covariance are \(B_{\rm lat}^{(c)}=I-QA^{(c)}Q^\top\) and \(\Omega_{\rm Sq}^{(c)}=Q\Omega^{(c)}Q^\top\). The relabeled graph obeys Squires’ order because \(u\to v\) becomes \(\rho(u)\to\rho(v)\) with \(\rho(u)>\rho(v)\). Each row of \(H_{\rm Sq}=Q\) has a unique largest-absolute entry \(+1\), so Assumption 1(c)’s normalization holds. Moreover,
> \[
> \mathcal B_j^{\rm Sq}
> =\mathcal B_0^{\rm Sq}
> +e_{\rho(j)}
> \left(\tau_j^{-1/2}e_{\rho(j)}
>       -(\mathcal B_0^{\rm Sq})^\top e_{\rho(j)}\right)^\top ,
> \]
> since \(Qc_j=\tau_j^{-1/2}e_{\rho(j)}-(\mathcal B_0^{\rm Sq})^\top e_{\rho(j)}\). Thus this is Squires’ perfect single-node intervention with \(\lambda_j=\tau_j^{-1/2}>0\). For a nonroot, the intervened coordinate row cannot be proportional to the baseline row because the latter has a nonzero parent entry; for a root proportionality is expressly allowed. Hence Assumption 1(b) is also satisfied.
>
> Re-derive the observable precision without dropping \(H_{\rm Sq}\):
> \[
> \Theta_c
> =H_{\rm Sq}^\top(\mathcal B_c^{\rm Sq})^\top
>   \mathcal B_c^{\rm Sq}H_{\rm Sq}
> =Q^\top(Q\mathcal C_cQ^\top)^\top
>   (Q\mathcal C_cQ^\top)Q
> =\mathcal C_c^\top\mathcal C_c
> =K_c.
> \]
> Therefore \(\Theta_c-\Theta_d=K_c-K_d\) for every pair of unchanged context labels \(c,d\); all pairwise ranks, the literal Proposition-10 score, and the symmetric score are exactly preserved.
>
> Propagate this repaired lemma as follows. In `prop:squires-rank-failure-full-domain`, invoke the permutation embedding to place each chain, fork, and open-star witness inside the Proposition-10 domain with the same scores; retain the negative-by-restriction caveat. In `thm:rank-selector-correction`, retain the positive certificate only on \(\mathcal M_p\) and cite the repaired proposition only for the full-domain negative refutation. In `thm:rank-only-impossibility`, delete the duplicated identity-mixing construction, retain \(\sigma=(0\,1)\) as the component swap, and invoke the repaired lemma with \(\rho,Q\): latent relabeling leaves context labels and \(R\) unchanged, so any selector universal on the full Squires class would restrict to the impossible star family. Replace every explicit \(G_{\rm Sq}=H_{\rm Sq}=I_p\) assertion in statements, proofs, TL;DR/related-work/honest-scope metadata with the \(G_{\rm Sq}=Q^\top,\ H_{\rm Sq}=Q\) construction. Do not broaden the positive certificate to latent mixing.
>
> Close `accepted_bank_omitted@thm:universal-recovery` in both `related_work` and the theorem’s gap text: explicitly compare against accepted-bank `eid_crl_coverratio_mmd_genericity_v1`. That result uses separately indexed observational/interventional laws, faithful positive nonlinear non-Gaussian compact-support mechanisms, arbitrary shared \(C^2\) diffeomorphic mixing, one unknown-target perfect intervention per latent node, and ratio/MMD genericity to recover latent coordinates/targets/DAG up to its stated equivalences. The present theorem instead starts from one pooled unlabeled centered-Gaussian mixture, permits unfaithful parameter points, observes the causal coordinates directly, and supplies exact component-covariance membership and full SEM-parameter recovery. It does not handle nonlinear latent mixing; the accepted-bank result does not identify a hidden baseline from a pooled Gaussian mixture or provide this covariance-tuple certificate. State that neither result subsumes the other.
>
> RECEIPT — `embedding-label-order`, both `embedding-not-established` findings, the rank-impossibility `embedding-label-order` finding, and `accepted_bank_omitted` are closed by the scoped construction above; novelty, tier, estimator-open-question status, and all \(\mathcal M_p\) theorem kernels remain unchanged.
